content_zh:
“猖狂！哪来的不知天高地厚的丫头！你才学了几年医, 就敢说血崩不能堵只能疏？见血止血是最明智的做法, 否则如你所说, 去疏通那血，血岂不是如河水，越流越快？越流越急？最终病情只会更严重！”
陈家华一脸懵相, 完全不明白这俩人是怎么对上的？且俩人说的都很有道理，只是观点完全对立，一个认为血崩要止血, 一个认为不能止血, 两个完全不同的做法会让治疗结果完全不同？
苏檀尊敬周奎正这样的老医生，可医生这行不是别的, 不管长幼尊卑, 在病人面前, 对就是对, 错就是错, 否则每一次的误诊, 都可能让病人丧命，这可不是小事情！
因此，苏檀无比坚持：
“是, 周老！我敬重您这样的老前辈, 可中西医对病情的治疗手段不同，西医一向以快速出结果为主要目的，见血止血看起来见效快，却会为病人埋下祸根，病如果不除根，以后还会犯，所以，我认为，不能止血！”
“荒唐！荒唐！”周奎正气得鼻孔冒烟，不禁吼道：“行！你能！你能你倒是试试看！”
他吼得很大声，就连楼下的封京墨都听到了，封京墨上楼，没方便进屋，便站在走廊尽头观望。
屋里不停传来争吵，封京墨忽然怀疑，自己带苏檀来的决定是不是错的。
忽然，大门家走了过来，他一身白色的练功服，头顶全秃，一双眼却很有精神，嘴角两撇白胡子，看起来面色红润，很有精神。
对方见了封京墨，先惊道：“京墨？你什么时候回来的？”
封京墨笑着扶起他的胳膊，道：“王叔，我回来有两天了，本打算去拜访您的。”
“上次和你爸下棋，还听他念叨说你要回来，一转眼，你去国外都几年了。”
封京墨笑笑没搭话，听到屋内的争吵声，王辅仁侧目不解：
“周奎正在里面？怎么还吵起来了？”
封京墨摇头：“恐是我带来的一个丫头不认同周院长的治疗方法。”
“哦？”王辅仁双眼一亮：“还有敢和周奎正那老古板对叫的？年轻人有前途！”
封京墨一滞，失笑道：“王叔你可别看热闹，进去后该训斥训斥，该责骂责骂她，能得您教导，是她的福气。”
王辅仁在“国医评选”中被评为国医，给国家领导人看了很多年病，在业内很有威望。
王辅仁笑了：“你这小子，什么时候见你对女人这样上心？怎么，这姑娘是你小女朋友？”
封京墨微怔，忙道：“哪里，是我侄媳，王叔你说笑了。”

“侄媳？哪个侄子的？”
“陵游的。”
“哦，他啊！”
王辅仁没说话，只不停摇头，进了屋里。
屋里还吵着呢，各执己见，苏檀要为陈夫人用药，周奎正不让，说她会扰乱自己的治疗方案。
忽然，门“来！辅仁你来的正好！你看看你们中医的后生，都是些什么人！”
王辅仁笑眯眯地盯着苏檀，苏檀忙说：
“是周老一直瞧不起中医，说什么治大病用不上中医。”
这话一出，周奎正脸猛地红了，他是说过类似的话，可王辅仁就是中医，当他面这样说，这不是揭他底吗？这丫头还真是一点面子不给他留，当下气得眼睛一瞪，去一旁生闷气了。
王辅仁呵呵笑了，边开药箱边问：
“我听你们在争论病人血崩的原因，怎么，有结果了吗？”
他看向苏檀，苏檀在对方的注视下，当下打起十二分精神，她虽不知道对方是什么级别的医生，可对方的气场很大，一看就不是凡人，若能得到他的认可，对她有利无弊。
想着，苏檀忙道：“我观陈夫人脉象，陈夫人气虚，在血崩前应该一直月经淋漓不尽，经期延长，时间不定。”
王辅仁没有意外，又笑眯眯问：“还有呢？”
“还有……”苏檀知道对方在考自己，语气平静道：“陈夫人虽然七日前才开始血崩，看似无缘无故，实则，我没猜错的话，陈夫人在血崩前应曾大量进补过。”
这话一出，王辅仁的脸色有了变化，他抬头看向陈家华，问：

"Rampant! Where does this girl come from? You have only studied medicine for a few years, and you dare to say that bleeding can't be blocked but only dredged? Stopping bleeding when it's seen is the wisest thing to do. Otherwise, as you said, if you try to dredge the blood, wouldn't the blood be like a river, flowing faster and faster? The more it flows, the faster it will become? In the end, the condition will only become more serious!"
Chen Jiahua looked confused and had no idea how these two people met. And what both of them said is very reasonable, but their views are completely opposite. One believes that bleeding must be stopped for hemorrhage, and the other believes that bleeding cannot be stopped. Two completely different methods will make the treatment results completely different?
Su Tan respects old doctors like Zhou Kuizheng, but the doctor's profession is nothing else. Regardless of seniority or inferiority, in front of patients, right is right and wrong is wrong. Otherwise, every misdiagnosis may cost the patient his life. This is no small matter!
Therefore, Su Tan is extremely insistent:
"Yes, Mr. Zhou! I respect seniors like you, but Chinese and Western medicine have different treatment methods for diseases. Western medicine always aims to produce quick results. Stopping bleeding at the sight of blood seems to be quick, but it will lay the root of trouble for the patient. If the disease is not eradicated, it will happen again in the future. Therefore, I think it cannot stop the bleeding!"
"Absurd! Ridiculous!" Zhou Kuizheng was so angry that smoke was coming out of his nostrils and he couldn't help shouting: "Okay! You can! If you can, you should give it a try!"
He roared so loudly that even Feng Jingmo downstairs heard it. Feng Jingmo went upstairs and couldn't enter the room conveniently, so he stood at the end of the corridor and watched.
There were constant quarrels in the room, and Feng Jingmo suddenly doubted whether his decision to bring Su Tan here was wrong.
Suddenly, the gatekeeper walked over. He was wearing white training clothes, with a completely bald head, but energetic eyes. He had a white beard at the corners of his mouth, and he looked rosy and energetic.
When the other party saw Feng Jingmo, he was surprised and said: "Jingmo? When did you come back?"
Feng Jingmo smiled and held up his arm, saying, "Uncle Wang, I've been back for two days and I planned to visit you."
"The last time I played chess with your dad, I heard him talking about you wanting to come back. In the blink of an eye, you have been abroad for several years."
Feng Jingmo smiled and said nothing. When he heard the quarrel in the room, Wang Furen glanced at him in confusion:
"Zhou Kui is inside? Why are you still arguing?"
Feng Jingmo shook his head: "I'm afraid one of the girls I brought here doesn't agree with Dean Zhou's treatment method."
"Oh?" Wang Furen's eyes lit up: "Who dares to argue with Zhou Kuizheng, an old-fashioned man? Young people have a bright future!"
Feng Jingmo hesitated, then laughed and said, "Uncle Wang, please don't watch the excitement. After entering, she should be scolded and scolded. She is lucky to have your guidance."
Wang Furen was rated as a national doctor in the "National Medical Selection". He has treated national leaders for many years and is very prestigious in the industry.
Wang Furen smiled: "You kid, when did you see you being so interested in a woman? What, this girl is your little girlfriend?"
Feng Jingmo was slightly startled and said hurriedly: "Where is it? It's my niece-in-law. Uncle Wang, are you kidding me?"
"Niece-in-law? Which nephew?"
"Lingyou."
"Oh, him!"
Wang Furen said nothing, just shook his head and entered the room.
There was still a quarrel in the room, everyone had their own opinions. Su Tan wanted to use medicine for Mrs. Chen, but Zhou Kuizheng refused, saying that she would disrupt his treatment plan.
Suddenly, the door said, "Come! Furen, you're here at the right time! Look at the students of your traditional Chinese medicine, who are they!"
Wang Furen stared at Su Tan with a smile, and Su Tan hurriedly said:
"It's Mr. Zhou who has always looked down on Chinese medicine, saying that Chinese medicine is not needed to treat serious illnesses."
As soon as these words came out, Zhou Kuizheng blushed suddenly. He had said similar words, but Wang Furen was a Chinese medicine doctor. If he said this in front of him, wouldn't this expose him? This girl really didn't save any face for him. She was so angry that she glared and went to the side to sulk.
Wang Furen laughed and asked while opening the medicine box:
"I heard you guys arguing about the cause of the patient's hemorrhage. What, is there any result?"
He looked at Su Tan. Under the other person's gaze, Su Tan immediately cheered up. Although she didn't know what level of doctor the other person was, she had a great aura and looked like he was not a mortal. If she could get his approval, it would be beneficial to her.
Thinking about it, Su Tan hurriedly said: "I looked at Mrs. Chen's pulse and found that Mrs. Chen was weak. Before the bleeding, she should have had continuous menstruation. The menstrual period was prolonged and the time was uncertain. "
Wang Furen was not surprised and asked with a smile: "What else? "
"Also..." Su Tan knew that the other party was testing her, and said in a calm tone: "Although Mrs. Chen began to have a hemorrhage seven days ago, seemingly for no reason, in fact, if I guessed correctly, Mrs. Chen should have taken a lot of supplements before the hemorrhage. "
